overall_notes: The extraction quality is generally good. The paper focuses on Open Domain Event Detection (ODED) where models generate event triggers, event types, and their definitions - this qualifies as NLG. The main contributions are the SEOE evaluation framework, benchmark construction, and semantic evaluation using LLMs as judges. Human evaluation was conducted with 3 professional annotators using the same prompts as LLM evaluators.
